# Emily Preble Auctions

> Benefit auctioneer and fundraising consultant based in Austin, Texas. Helps nonprofits raise more through charisma, strategy, and heart. Certified Benefit Auctioneer Specialist (BAS). TX Auctioneer License #18523.

Emily Preble is a Certified Benefit Auctioneer Specialist (BAS) and licensed auctioneer based in Austin, Texas. A Portland, Oregon native, she partners with nonprofits across the United States to elevate live fundraising events. Her background includes Division I college athletics (softball captain and catcher), professional journalism, and brand strategy — a combination that informs her storytelling-driven approach to benefit auctioneering.

## Services

- **Live Auctioneering** — High-energy auction leadership focused on fundraising success.
- **Fund-a-Need Coaching** — Emotionally resonant appeal development for donor engagement.
- **Pre-Event Strategy & Consulting** — Run-of-show planning, donor strategy, event flow.
- **Scriptwriting & Messaging** — Mission-focused language and storytelling.
- **Emceeing & On-Site Leadership** — Program facilitation from welcome to closing.
- **Branded Materials & Visual Assets** — Custom signage, slide decks, donor materials.
- **Guides & Strategic Takeaways** — Donor mindset guides, planning worksheets, checklists.

## Service area

Based in Austin, Texas. Serves benefit and fundraising events nationwide, with frequent work across Texas (Austin, Houston, Dallas, San Antonio).
